name: Potato Games
description:
Welcome to Potato Games- an amazing Minecraft Bedrock Minigame server! Unlike other Minigame servers, Potato Games relies entirely on command blocks to control everything. This makes the games feel more vanilla than other servers that use plugins.

Potato Games has a lot of games to enjoy: Spleef, PvP, Skywars, and the exclusive Hot Potato and Mine Madness are all our multiplayer games. Single player games include Skyblock, Prisons, Parkour, and the mysterious Backrooms games. There are also games scattered around the lobby and tons to explore.

You should play Potato Games if you want to have a fun time, whether you play a lot or a little. Even if no one else is online, the single-player experiences have a lot of content and are super fun!

New features are added every few months, including expansions to the lobby, new PvP maps, and sometimes even entire new games!

Join Potato Games today!

Check out our website to learn more: https://www.potatogames.site

Join our discord: https://discord.gg/qQ64FtTNjx

Watch our YouTube: https://youtube.com/@mcpotatogames
